finding.summary: Hardcoded 'nvm use 24' assumes Node 24 is installed via nvm. If nvm is not available or Node 24 is not installed, the script fails silently (output redirected to /dev/null) with a confusing error later from promptfoo.
finding.fix: Add explicit check: if ! command -v nvm >/dev/null; then echo "ERROR: nvm not found" >&2; exit 1; fi. Also verify Node 24 is available: nvm ls 24 >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: Node 24 not installed via nvm" >&2; exit 1; }

label: false_positive
label_reason: under set -e a failing `nvm use 24` stops the script, and only its stdout is silenced, so its error is shown.
notes: finding.line moved 26 -> 31: at raised_sha fee8a9a the `nvm use 24` the finding describes is at run_eval.sh:31 (26 is mkdir); the review cited the wrong line.
